title: The Bridge That Took Nine Years
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：factor　|　正文 372 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 factor 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My father spent nine years on one bridge, which is either patience or stubbornness depending on who is telling it. He was not the engineer; he was the man who checked the numbers. The first ① factor in any calculation, he told me when I was eleven, is knowing which number you do not have. He said it again every summer of my childhood, usually while ② factoring the cost of concrete into a column of figures on the back of an envelope.

The bridge crossed a river that rose four metres in spring. Water was the ③ factor everybody understood and nobody controlled. Ice was the one they forgot. In the third winter a slab of it took out two piers, and the whole design had to be reworked with a ④ factor of safety large enough to make the engineers argue for a month. My father's own factor in the disagreement was small; he only supplied the numbers, and cost was the factor nobody wanted to name.

He taught me arithmetic on site. Three, he said, is a ⑤ factor of twelve and of thirty, and a grown man who cannot see that will misjudge a load by more than he can afford. Loads were the part I liked: a truck is a ⑥ factor of about eight when a road is designed, meaning every axle counts eight times over in the wear it causes. He wrote it out in chalk on a wall and left it there through three rains.

What I could not learn from him was patience. The ⑦ deciding factor, in the end, was not engineering at all but a change of council, a change of budget, and one letter from a woman who had written every year since the first plan was drawn. Nobody could ⑧ factor her persistence into any formula, and it was the only thing that survived every revision.

The bridge opened when I was twenty. ⑨ Factor in nine years of delays, my father said at the ceremony, and you still get a thing that will outlast us both. He is right, and he is also ⑩ a factor I have never been able to leave out of any decision since: ask what the number would be if nobody were watching.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. （数学的）因子；因数（a factor of）
C. n. 系数；倍率（a factor of eight 八倍）
D. v. 把……计入；把……作为因素考虑（factor sth in/into）
E. 固定搭配：factor of safety 安全系数
F. 固定搭配：the deciding factor 决定性因素
G. n. （某人所起的）作用；分量
H. 固定搭配：the first factor in ... ……中的首要因素

items.q: The first factor in any calculation
while factoring the cost of concrete into
Water was the factor everybody understood
a factor of safety large enough
is a factor of twelve and of thirty
a truck is a factor of about eight
Nobody could factor her persistence into any formula
Factor in nine years of delays
he is also a factor I have never been able to leave out

answers.why: the first factor in any calculation 意为“任何计算中的首要因素”，指先弄清缺哪个数据。
factor sth into 是动词用法，意为“把……计入”，此处指把混凝土成本算进一列数字。
水是人人明白却无法控制的“因素”。
factor of safety 是固定术语，意为“安全系数”。
3 是 12 和 30 的“因数”，用的是数学义。
a factor of about eight 指“约八倍”，是系数、倍率义。
the deciding factor 意为“决定性因素”，此处说最终起决定作用的不是工程本身。
同样作动词，意为“把……纳入考虑”，说她的坚持无法被写进任何公式。
factor in 意为“把……计入”，指把九年延误算进去。
指父亲本人在作者决策中所起的“分量、作用”，即无法忽略的一个因素。

三是十二和三十的因数。（a factor of）

answers: The first factor in any calculation is knowing which number you do not have.
Water was the factor everybody understood and nobody controlled.
The whole design was reworked with a large enough factor of safety.
Three is a factor of twelve and of thirty.
When a road is designed, a truck counts as a factor of about eight.
Nobody could factor her persistence into any formula.
